message.content:
The median (i.e., the middle value) of all residential home prices in California is roughly **$800,000–$850,000** as of the most recent data from Zillow and the U.S. Census Bureau (2024).  

If you’re looking for the *average* (mean) price, it tends to be a bit higher—typically in the **$900,000–$1,000,000** range—because a handful of very expensive homes pull the mean up.  

These figures are based on the latest publicly available housing market reports (Zillow Home Value Index, 2024; U.S. Census Bureau’s American Community Survey, 2023).
